VISITOR COURTESIES
• Mentor Lagoons Nature Preserve is a wildlife
preserve. Please help keep it clean to protect
and preserve its native plants and animals.
• Visitors are asked to stay on marked trails.
Unmarked trails are not maintained or
monitored by park personnel.
• The nature preserve closes at dusk.
• Parking is permitted in designated
areas only.
• Swimming is prohibited.
• Dogs must be restrained by a lead or a
leash and under the control of a responsible
person at all times. No pets are permitted on
the Marsh Rim Trail.
• Bicycles are NOT permitted along the Marsh
Rim Trail.
• All-terrain vehicles, motorcycles, and all
other motorized vehicles are NOT permitted
within the Mentor Lagoons Nature Preserve.
• Enjoy our facilities, but be respectful of the
rights of other visitors.
• Please report any vandalism at the marina
office.
• Please place litter in the receptacles
provided.
• No alcohol is permitted in the nature
preserve.
• Keep amplified music at a reasonable level.
• If an emergency arises, call 911.
